incomplete_non_blocking.limitation: The historical generation-model comparison uses the OpenAI retrieval profile; its GPT-5.4 generation trade-off is directional evidence and the passing BGE quality report remains authoritative for the selected profile.
The historical three-mode retrieval comparison uses OpenAI embeddings and reranking, so it demonstrates the required alternatives but does not substitute for the selected BGE profile quality gate.
The historical cache comparison has incomplete paired candidate evidence and no recommendation; official performance traffic therefore bypasses cache and no cache benefit is claimed.

limitations: The 100-request single-instance sample is MVP evidence and is not a production capacity guarantee.
The local BGE cost uses a declared USD 0.50 per GPU-hour workstation allocation rate and the measured load duration.
Historical comparison reports are partial cross-profile supporting evidence and are not used for mandatory quality, performance, or cost gates.
Evaluation-only judge cost is unavailable and is not represented as zero.
